Thanks for helping test BubblePlug on Apple Silicon. The app has a Universal
build, but its arm64 slice has not yet been exercised by the project maintainers
on Apple Silicon hardware.

### What you tried

- Did BubblePlug launch?
- Did it connect to Live?
- Did plugin search and loading work? Which plugin formats did you try?
